definition_quote.value: The practice of the profession of public accountancy is defined as: 1. offering to perform or performing attest and/or compilation services; 2. incident to such services, offering to perform or performing professional services for clients in matters relating to accounting concepts and to the recording, presentation, or certification of financial information or data; or 3. offering to perform or performing, for other persons one or more types of services including but not limited to accounting, management advisory, financial advisory, and tax.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of the profession of public accountancy is defined as: 1. offering to perform or performing attest and/or compilation services, as defined in section seventy-four hundred one-a of this article;

value: attest services (audit, review, examination, PCAOB engagement)
methods_authorized.quote: offering to perform or performing, for other persons one or more types of the following services including but not limited to accounting, management advisory, financial advisory, and tax

value: audit in accordance with generally accepted auditing standards or similar standards
review of a financial statement in accordance with applicable standards
examination in accordance with attestation standards
engagement in accordance with PCAOB auditing standards
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest" means providing the following public accountancy services which all require the independence of licensees: a. any audit to be performed in accordance with generally accepted auditing standards or other similar standards... b. any review of a financial statement... c. any examination to be performed in accordance with attestation standards... d. any engagement to be performed in accordance with the auditing standards of the public company accounting oversight board.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service that presents, in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of the management or owners of the client without undertaking to express any assurance of the accuracy of the information in the statements
